# AVM submodule — Role Assignment (`Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments`)

Creates a single Azure RBAC role assignment scoped to an arbitrary parent resource. The submodule expects a fully-resolved `role_definition_resource_id`; name-based role lookups are performed by the parent module.

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD033 -->

The following requirements are needed by this module:

- <a name="requirement_terraform"></a> [terraform](#requirement\_terraform) (>= 1.9, < 2.0)

- <a name="requirement_azapi"></a> [azapi](#requirement\_azapi) (~> 2.8)

- <a name="requirement_random"></a> [random](#requirement\_random) (~> 3.5)
